name: Tree-Sitter Context Indexing
purpose: Build and query language-agnostic code-context indexes with tree-sitter: pinned multi-language parsing, declarative capture queries, syntax-aligned chunking, and incremental re-parsing for AI agent context retrieval.
inputs: Target languages with pinned tree-sitter grammar revisions
Checked-in .scm query files declaring captures the index consumes
Chunking policy: max bytes, splittable node types, overlap rules
Golden node set with expected captures per language
outputs: Pinned multi-language parser set with verified extraction queries
Syntax-aligned chunk index queryable by capture, name, imports, and symbol
Parse quality, throughput, and capture-recall report
stop_conditions: Capture recall reaches 100% on goldens with query p95 under 200 ms on a warm index
Incremental re-parse of a one-line edit completes in under 15 ms on reference files
